import sys

class FastScanner:
    def __init__(self):
        self.buf = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        self.pos = 0

    def next_long(self):
        while self.pos < len(self.buf) and self.buf[self.pos] <= 32:
            self.pos += 1
        neg = False
        if self.pos < len(self.buf) and self.buf[self.pos] == 45:  # '-'
            neg = True
            self.pos += 1
        res = 0
        while self.pos < len(self.buf) and 48 <= self.buf[self.pos] <= 57:
            res = res * 10 + (self.buf[self.pos] - 48)
            self.pos += 1
        return -res if neg else res

def main():
    sc = FastScanner()
    N = sc.next_long()
    M = sc.next_long()
    L = sc.next_long()
    R = sc.next_long()

    mod = 998244353
    MOD = mod
    length = R - L + 1
    E = length // 2 + (1 if R % 2 == 0 and L % 2 == 0 else 0)
    O = length - E
    nm = N * M

    if nm % 2 == 1:
        ans = pow(E + O, nm, MOD)
    else:
        ans = (pow(E + O, nm, MOD) + pow(E - O, nm, MOD)) % MOD
        ans = ans * pow(2, MOD - 2, MOD) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
